description: Daily Tehran open-market closing rate of a currency in Toman, with Gregorian and Jalali (Persian calendar) dates. Give `days` (back from today) or `from`/`to` (YYYY-MM-DD, Gregorian or Jalali such as 1404-01-01). Without a key: the last 365 days; a Pro FX API key reaches the whole archive (the dollar back to 1360 / 1981). At most 400 points per call; longer windows are sampled. نرخ پایانی روزانهٔ بازار آزاد با تاریخ شمسی و میلادی.

code.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, EUR, AED, TRY, GBP, CNY, IQD.

days.description: Days back from today (default 30). Ignored when `from` is given.

from.description: Start day, YYYY-MM-DD, Gregorian or Jalali.

to.description: End day, YYYY-MM-DD, Gregorian or Jalali. Default: today.

name: get_history
title: Daily rate history (تاریخچهٔ روزانهٔ نرخ)
